blocks.text: Crystallization ka bunyadi usool (principle) yeh hai ke solute kisi munasib solvent mein zyada temperature par hal ho jaye, aur jab solution ko thanda kiya jaye to zaid (extra) solute crystals ki shakal mein bahar nikal aaye. Crystallization ke process mein yeh qadam (steps) hote hain.
Solvent ka intikhab (Choice of a Solvent)
Achhe (ideal) solvent mein yeh khoobiyan honi chahiyen:

items: Woh apne boiling point par madde ki zyada miqdar hal kare, lekin room temperature par sirf thori miqdar.
Woh solute se chemically react na kare.
Woh impurities (milawat) ko hal hi na kare, ya agar kare to impurities solute ke saath crystals na banayen.
Thanda hone par woh khalis (pure) compound ke achhe bane crystals de.
Woh sasta ho, istemal mein mehfooz (safe) ho aur aasani se hataya ja sake.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Crystallization ke dauran kabhi kabhi filtration karte waqt hi crystals banne lagte hain. Is se filter paper ya funnel band (choke) ho jata hai. Is se bachne ke liye hot water funnel (garam pani wala funnel) istemal kiya ja sakta hai.
Crystallization ke liye zyada tar yeh solvents istemal hote hain: pani, absolute ethanol, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride aur acetic acid.

Agar in mein se koi solvent munasib na ho to do ya zyada miscible solvents (jo aapas mein mil jate hain) mila kar istemal kiye ja sakte hain. Agar solvent inflammable (jaldi aag pakarne wala) ho to solution garam karte waqt ehtiyat karni chahiye taake aag na lage. Aise mein garam karne ke liye water bath istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Solvent aisa chahiye jo garam hone par zyada aur thanda hone par kam madda hal kare. Garam solution thanda hota hai to woh itna madda sambhal nahi pata, aur zaid madda khalis crystals ban kar nikal aata hai; impurities solution mein reh jati hain.

items: Crystallization: garam solvent mein hal karein, thanda kar ke crystals nikalein.
Achha solvent: garam mein zyada, thande mein kam hal kare; react na kare; impurities alag rakhe; achhe crystals de; sasta, safe, aasani se hatne wala.
Aam solvents: pani, ethanol, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride, acetic acid; inflammable solvent ke liye water bath; filtration mein crystals se bachne ko hot water funnel.
